title: Naples Saltwater Fishing
specs: Newest and nicest charter boat in Naples
Fishing for tarpon, spotted seatrout, mangrove snapper, cobia, kingfish, tuna, snook, redfish, grouper, and more
Use of freshly caught live bait and adherence to state laws
Rates are for up to 4 adults
includes: All bait, tackle, bottled water, and ice included
Catch filleted and bagged to enjoy later
blurb: Guests fish in the Gulf of Mexico on a private charter boat with Captain Tony. Trips range from 4 to 8 hours and include all licenses, permits, bait, tackle, bottled water, and ice. Catch is filleted and bagged for guests to take home.
extraNote: Trip cancellations must be done within five days of scheduled trip or full charge applies · Meet Captain Tony at the dock in Naples
